title: WRC FIA WORLD RALLY CHAMPIONSHIP
description: WRC: FIA World Rally Championship é um videogame de corrida desenvolvido pela Travellers Tales para o PlayStation Portable. O jogo apresenta conteúdo do Campeonato Mundial de Rally de 2005, que também foi apresentado em WRC: Rally Evolved.
description_en: WRC: FIA World Rally Championship is a racing video game developed by Travelers Tales for the PlayStation Portable. The game features content from the 2005 World Rally Championship, which was also featured in WRC: Rally Evolved.
description_es: WRC: FIA World Rally Championship es un videojuego de carreras desarrollado por Travelers Tales para PlayStation Portable. El juego presenta contenido del Campeonato Mundial de Rally de 2005, que también apareció en WRC: Rally Evolved.
